author: BajuBesi Labs
name: BajuBesi Labs Red Cogs
short: Cogs for Red-DiscordBot by BajuBesi Labs: an Enshrouded server panel and a music jukebox.
description: Cogs made for the BajuBesi Discord: an Enshrouded dedicated-server status panel with news, and a jukebox panel with buttons on top of Red's Audio cog.
install_msg: Thanks for adding BajuBesi Labs' cogs! Install one with `[p]cog install bajubesi <cog>`, then `[p]load <cog>`.
